title: Joining on Non-Indexed Columns
damaged_code:
```sql
SELECT * FROM orders o 
JOIN shipping_details s ON o.tracking_code = s.tracking_code; -- tracking_code is unindexed
```
pattern: Executing SQL join operations on columns that lack indexes.
why_bad: Forces the database engine to perform O(N) sequential table scans, reading every physical block from the disk to find matching rows, destroying performance as data volume scales.
detection: Join statements where the target attributes in the `ON` clause do not have matching database index entries.
counterexample: Small table structures with negligible rows (< 100 rows) where index scans are slower than table scans. `Contextual`.
fix: Create explicit indexes on columns used in join clauses or foreign key relationships.
